Depths: TokenContract depth 17, PrivateNote depth 20, InferenceOrderBook depth 31, RootModel depth 8, SuperRoot depth 7, RootPN depth 14, RootOracle depth 9, ModelRegistry depth 8, PMP depth 20, OrderBook depth 28, OracleEventList depth 12, Oracle depth 10, Nullifier depth 6. A file can lag a deploy; the chain cannot.

status: DEPLOYED - shellnet runs 4.0.35, verified read-only from this tree rather than assumed. The four fixed root accounts under dapp 4 (SuperRoot 0:0c0c, ModelRegistry 0:0d0d, RootPN 0:1010, RootOracle 0:1515) are Active and serve exactly the code hashes recorded above; RootPN answers getVersion() == ("4.0.35", "RootPN") and getDetails() with privateNoteCodeHash 57e85fa6 / pmpCodeHash 07fcc9fd, which is the code it actually mints. Because the four root images are the committed artifacts, the compile-time pins inside them are the ones in this tree's sources: RootPN pins TokenContract a67e1ae0 depth 17 and RootModel 287831 depth 8, SuperRoot pins RootModel 287831, InferenceOrderBook pins PrivateNote 57e85fa6 depth 20, ModelRegistry pins InferenceOrderBook 2fa52109 depth 31. THREE GAPS ARE NAMED. (1) Seven of the thirteen are deployed per-deal or per-model, so no instance of this generation exists on chain to read; their hashes are reproduced from the artifacts, corroborated by the six that were read live. (2) No functional scenario has been exercised against this build by this client: every note that existed is the wrong generation and a fresh pool is being minted. (3) The ModelRegistry set is wiped by updateCode and must be re-seeded before any name resolves; the re-seed carries 8558 strings this generation rather than booleans.
